strings.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
strings.summary: Born in Israel and educated in America, Netanyahu served as diplomat, repeatedly as prime minister and as Likud leader, shaping security and Palestinian policy. After Hamas’s 2023 attack he led the Gaza war, with severe humanitarian catastrophe and international accountability efforts. He denies domestic corruption and ICC allegations. His coalition lost its majority in 2026; he remained caretaker premier at cutoff.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Served repeatedly as Israel’s prime minister; his security, regional diplomacy and Palestinian policies profoundly influence Middle Eastern politics and international controversy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: MIT architecture bachelor’s (1975) and management master’s (1976).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Long tenure
strings.highlights.h1.text: Repeated premierships shaped Israeli security and domestic politics.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Regional diplomacy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Israel normalised relations with the UAE and Bahrain in 2020 during his tenure.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Post-election caretaker government
strings.timeline.t1.text: Coalition lost its majority; Eisenkot received a formation mandate, with no new government by cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: ICC arrest warrant
strings.timeline.t2.text: For alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity; he denies allegations, and a warrant is not a conviction.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Judicial reform and Gaza war
strings.timeline.t3.text: Reform sparked mass protests; war after Hamas’s attack brought severe humanitarian crisis.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Returned as premier
strings.timeline.t4.text: Led a coalition in December after a period in opposition.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Corruption trial opened
strings.timeline.t5.text: Tried for bribery, fraud and breach of trust; he denies wrongdoing.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Prime minister again
strings.timeline.t6.text: Led a new coalition, beginning a tenure lasting until 2021.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First premiership
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won the direct prime-ministerial election, serving until 1999.
strings.timeline.t8.title: UN ambassador
strings.timeline.t8.text: Represented Israel in multilateral diplomacy until 1988.
strings.timeline.t9.title: MIT management degree
strings.timeline.t9.text: Earned master’s, continuing in business and public affairs.
strings.timeline.t10.title: Born in Tel Aviv
strings.timeline.t10.text: Born in Israel and spent part of his youth in America.
